body:
Picks up the remaining delta from [`self-evolving/repo`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo) main (`60c1cd5`) that wasn't included in the previous sync (PR #23).

## Changes

- **`.skills/distill-rubrics/SKILL.md`** (new) — skill for distilling durable rubric preferences from agent execution histories.
- **`.skills/install-agent/SKILL.md`** (new) — skill for installing the Sepo agent into another repository.
- **`.skills/update-agent/SKILL.md`** (new) — skill for upgrading an existing Sepo agent installation.
- **`AGENT.md`** (new) — top-level agent documentation describing how to use the agent and trigger workflows.
- **`.gitignore`** — added `.claude/worktrees/` entry (from upstream).

`.agent/` and `.github/` agent assets are already in sync from PR #23 and were not changed.

## Validation

- `npm --prefix .agent test`: 387/387 pass
- YAML lint: all workflow, action, and template YAML valid
- `git diff --check`: whitespace clean

Closes #22.
title: chore: add .skills/, AGENT.md, and .gitignore entry from upstream self-evolving/repo
